verdict.rationale: Operating a relay server through natural-language commands is a fair axis for infrastructure tooling, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows MoQ Relay accepting natural-language commands: the CLI imports and publishes broadcasts using conventional formats, and an llms.txt docs file is a documentation aid, not a natural-language control interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
